name: qfd_io_collective_w3-g1-COMMIT
purpose: PLANNING KIT (not for submission until the r4/r4b/d2 leaves are CLOSED + native PASS and the compute die lead publishes the qfd_io_collective pin file): Qwen TP8 compute-die collective cluster under its die name (rtl/physical/ot_qfd_io_collective.sv = ot_coll_tp8_die WT 3 / DEPTH 64 / LQ-TQ 128 / STRAP 1). Rows c = 0..3: r3 leaf (MY: link face W) | pre-fold slice | d64 engine column leaf | engine fold slice; row 4: meta d64 leaf + flat controller / metadata column.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_io_collective u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qfd_io_collective.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_tp8_die.sv rtl/rom/ot_rom_oneshot_die_m.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_tp8_col3.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_rst_leaf.sv rtl/lib/ot_hdly.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_w3/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_w3/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_w3 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_io_collective --macro-view physical/ref_tile/coll_col_d64/views/ot_coll_col_tile_d64 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/coll_fold_slice_rt/views/ot_coll_fold_slice --macro-view physical/ref_tile/coll_tp8_colr3/views/ot_coll_tp8_col_tile_r3 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
